items.s: The experts who write dictionaries are called ____.
When they decide that a word has ____ power, they can add it.
"Delulu" is a playful, ____ word.
Many slang words are popular for a short time and then ____.
A dictionary is a ____ of how people use words.

match.d: people who write or edit dictionaries
very casual words that are popular with a certain group
facts that help you decide whether something is true
used with friends, not in careful writing or speech

items.s: In August 2025, the Cambridge Dictionary ____ some new words from the internet.
Dictionary experts ____ how words are used in books and online.
First, the word "skibidi" ____ popular because of a YouTube series. Then the dictionary included it.
In the last twelve months, the dictionary included more than 6,000 words, but many other words ____ not get in.
They look for words that people keep ____, not only for a week or a month.

tfn.s: Some internet words joined the Cambridge Dictionary in August 2025.
tfn.why: The text says: "In August 2025, the Cambridge Dictionary added some new words from the internet."

tfn.s: "Skibidi" grew popular because of a cooking show.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "It became popular because of a YouTube series called Skibidi Toilet."

tfn.s: "Delulu" is now used in school exams.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say whether "delulu" is used in school exams.

tfn.s: Words can be dropped from a dictionary when nobody uses them any more.
tfn.why: The text says: "Words can also leave a dictionary when people stop using them."

tfn.s: If a word is not in a dictionary, it must be wrong.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "that does not make it wrong or fake"

items.s: Dictionary editors closely ____ how words are used in books, newspapers and online.
The words showed staying power, which means that people were likely to keep ____ them.
Slang is often ____, so the decision is difficult.
A dictionary is a record of how a language is used, not a list of ____.
Choosing words for your ____ is part of knowing a language.

match.d: people who write or edit dictionaries
careful checking before something is accepted
lasting for only a very short time
the people who read or listen to what you say

items.s: The dictionary ____ a handful of internet slang words in August 2025.

tfn.s: More than 6,000 words joined the dictionary in the previous twelve months.
tfn.why: The text says: "The dictionary added more than 6,000 words in the previous twelve months"

tfn.s: Stollznow says a word that is not in a dictionary is not real.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "a word's absence from a particular dictionary does not make it any less real or valid"

tfn.s: Cambridge plans to add more slang words next year.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say whether Cambridge will add more slang next year.

tfn.s: A dictionary can show readers that a word is informal.
tfn.why: The text says: "A dictionary can also tell you when a word is informal."

tfn.s: A dictionary entry tells readers to use slang in every situation.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "a dictionary entry is not a recommendation to use slang everywhere"

items.s: Slang is a difficult case, because it is often ____.

Some users may find that spoils the fun, but others will ____ using it.

match.d: careful checking before something is accepted
lasting for only a very short time
to watch something carefully over a period of time
willing to be dishonest to get what you want

items.s: A word's ____ from a dictionary does not make it any less real.
Words can also be removed, but ____ is not taken lightly.
Adding a word involves a careful review of its usage and ____.
____ does not make a word correct everywhere.

tfn.s: Stollznow says slang often fails to survive the vetting process.
tfn.why: The text says: "slang frequently fails to survive the vetting process"

tfn.s: Stollznow says a word that is not in a dictionary is not real.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "a word's absence from a dictionary does not make it any less real"

tfn.s: Cambridge plans to add more slang next year.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say whether Cambridge will add more slang next year.

tfn.s: Words can be removed from a dictionary when they fall out of use.
tfn.why: The text says: "Words can also be removed when they fall out of use"

tfn.s: A dictionary entry can tell a speaker who is listening to them.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "It cannot tell you who is listening."
